units.displayText: Are you drunk, Professor? If you don't mind, then why not rest your head on your Daiyan? I don't mind offering my lap as your pillow.

spans.text: Are you drunk, Professor? If you don't mind, then why not rest your head on your Daiyan? I don't mind offering my lap as your pillow.

units.rawText: There is a saying, "In vino veritas". In wine, there is truth. I would like to know you better and share more stories about myself with you, Professor.
units.displayText: There is a saying, "In vino veritas". In wine, there is truth. I would like to know you better and share more stories about myself with you, Professor.

spans.text: There is a saying, "In vino veritas". In wine, there is truth. I would like to know you better and share more stories about myself with you, Professor.

units.rawText: I lean against her and lay myself down. Her lovely features are surprisingly clear in my dazzled vision.
units.displayText: I lean against her and lay myself down. Her lovely features are surprisingly clear in my dazzled vision.

spans.text: I lean against her and lay myself down. Her lovely features are surprisingly clear in my dazzled vision.

units.rawText: The only sound in the room comes from the fluttering of the firefly's wings. The window is shut and it cannot leave, so it has no choice but to flutter around by the edge of the table.
units.displayText: The only sound in the room comes from the fluttering of the firefly's wings. The window is shut and it cannot leave, so it has no choice but to flutter around by the edge of the table.

spans.text: The only sound in the room comes from the fluttering of the firefly's wings. The window is shut and it cannot leave, so it has no choice but to flutter around by the edge of the table.

units.rawText: It seems I am like this firefly; so thoroughly trapped that I am unable to escape.
units.displayText: It seems I am like this firefly; so thoroughly trapped that I am unable to escape.

spans.text: It seems I am like this firefly; so thoroughly trapped that I am unable to escape.

units.rawText: And do you think I am not equally bound?
units.displayText: And do you think I am not equally bound?

spans.text: And do you think I am not equally bound?

units.rawText: Huh?
units.displayText: Huh?

spans.text: Huh?

units.rawText: This firefly loved the light and entered the room, seeking a candle flame. Your Daiyan has given you her heart, wanting nothing more than to accompany you for all time, and never shall the two of us part.
units.displayText: This firefly loved the light and entered the room, seeking a candle flame. Your Daiyan has given you her heart, wanting nothing more than to accompany you for all time, and never shall the two of us part.

spans.text: This firefly loved the light and entered the room, seeking a candle flame. Your Daiyan has given you her heart, wanting nothing more than to accompany you for all time, and never shall the two of us part.

units.rawText: Now that I think about it, perhaps we are both fireflies chasing each other's light, with neither reluctance nor regret.
units.displayText: Now that I think about it, perhaps we are both fireflies chasing each other's light, with neither reluctance nor regret.

spans.text: Now that I think about it, perhaps we are both fireflies chasing each other's light, with neither reluctance nor regret.

units.rawText: Daiyan's ivory hands caress my face, and the places where she touched seem to burn with spicy heat.
units.displayText: Daiyan's ivory hands caress my face, and the places where she touched seem to burn with spicy heat.

spans.text: Daiyan's ivory hands caress my face, and the places where she touched seem to burn with spicy heat.

units.rawText: Hehe, your face is so red, Professor.
units.displayText: Hehe, your face is so red, Professor.

spans.text: Hehe, your face is so red, Professor.

units.rawText: She lowers her head, and a fragrant aroma washes over me. The drink has numbed my senses and her gentle scent sets my head spinning.
units.displayText: She lowers her head, and a fragrant aroma washes over me. The drink has numbed my senses and her gentle scent sets my head spinning.

spans.text: She lowers her head, and a fragrant aroma washes over me. The drink has numbed my senses and her gentle scent sets my head spinning.

units.rawText: Tell me, in days of old, what did the oathed couple do after finishing their exchange of toasts?
units.displayText: Tell me, in days of old, what did the oathed couple do after finishing their exchange of toasts?

spans.text: Tell me, in days of old, what did the oathed couple do after finishing their exchange of toasts?

units.rawText: Hoho, well, if you understood the meaning of the toasts, then how could you not know what comes next?
units.displayText: Hoho, well, if you understood the meaning of the toasts, then how could you not know what comes next?

spans.text: Hoho, well, if you understood the meaning of the toasts, then how could you not know what comes next?

units.rawText: We draw closer and closer to each other. Daiyan's eyes are filled with passion, which she pours all over me amidst the flickering candlelight.
units.displayText: We draw closer and closer to each other. Daiyan's eyes are filled with passion, which she pours all over me amidst the flickering candlelight.

spans.text: We draw closer and closer to each other. Daiyan's eyes are filled with passion, which she pours all over me amidst the flickering candlelight.

units.rawText: Still lying down, I wave my hand and extinguish the nearby candle. The moon beyond the window is now the only source of light for her beshadowed bedchamber. In the darkness, her hands find mine, and our fingers mesh together.
units.displayText: Still lying down, I wave my hand and extinguish the nearby candle. The moon beyond the window is now the only source of light for her beshadowed bedchamber. In the darkness, her hands find mine, and our fingers mesh together.

spans.text: Still lying down, I wave my hand and extinguish the nearby candle. The moon beyond the window is now the only source of light for her beshadowed bedchamber. In the darkness, her hands find mine, and our fingers mesh together.

units.rawText: <color=orange>Will you, Professor?</color>
units.displayText: Will you, Professor?

spans.text: Will you, Professor?

units.rawText: Hehe, oh you...
units.displayText: Hehe, oh you...

spans.text: Hehe, oh you...

units.rawText: We have a long night ahead of us; ample time to bare our feelings—so and much more—to each other.
units.displayText: We have a long night ahead of us; ample time to bare our feelings—so and much more—to each other.

spans.text: We have a long night ahead of us; ample time to bare our feelings—so and much more—to each other.
